purpose: Freeze decision-time provenance for D09/D10 industry, supply-chain, inventory, capacity and raw-material evidence before any outcome test.
knownAtRules: Use official release timestamp when explicitly published and the captured content is proven to be that release vintage.
Otherwise use capturedAt conservatively; never infer an earlier knownAt from observation month.
A later revised/final file must be stored as a new vintage, never overwrite or backdate the earlier vintage.
If a source is stale, inaccessible, or its release clock is ambiguous, mark UNKNOWN/BLOCKED rather than forward-fill.
eventClockRules: For supply-chain material events preserve announcement/publication clock separately from economic effective date.
First market-actionable session T0 is the first eligible decision session after knownAt.
If effectiveAt is later than knownAt, research information-arrival and economic-effect clocks separately.
Do not backdate a relationship or capacity event from a later termination/ramp disclosure.
protectedRules: No outcome lookup before source/taxonomy mapping is frozen.
